prompts.name: appointments
prompts.prompt: Create ONE finished square application icon for an existing GUC enterprise UI. The attached screenshot is only a style reference: match its glossy deep emerald glass rounded-square tiles, beveled green edges, dimensional ivory and warm gold objects, restrained specular highlights. Produce only the standalone icon, not a screenshot or layout. Center a rounded-square deep forest green tile, nearly filling the canvas with approximately 3 percent transparent margin. Front view, coherent soft lighting from upper left, refined small 3D objects with bold clean silhouettes readable at 34 to 48 pixels. No text, letters, digits, brand mark, captions or watermark. Transparent outside the tile. Subject: customer appointments: a large ivory appointment calendar with two binder rings and a gold checkmark, plus a small emerald-rimmed clock at the lower right. Minimal detail, strong readable silhouette.
